page.layout: Top: a running head "DE SENSIBUS EXTERNIS." and the page number 149. Above the ornament, a continuation paragraph from the previous page, full width. Below an ornamental rule, a centred chapter heading. Then one text column with notes in the right margin. Below the text, the gathering signature K 3 at the right.

Judicium sensus communis est duplex, sim-
plex, & compositum.
Judicium simplex est de quâcunq; re per
sensus cognitâ: ut de lapide.
Judicium compositum est quidâ quasi dis-
cursus ab uno sensili praesenti ad aliud per col-

I. Comparatorum cum comparatis, put[?]

page.notes: The ornamental rule above the chapter heading is a printer's ornament, not text. The mark after "put" in item I is unclear and may be a superscript or accent. The accent on "accuratiùs" and the ligatures in "Expofita" and "quae" are copied as best seen. No catchword is printed.
